address: via Sauris di Sotto 38, Sauris, 33020, Italy
bio: Sauris is situated in a slightly secluded location which adds to its appeal. Occupying a beautiful 17C house near a charming little lake and picturesque mountain village, this restaurant has been run by the same family since 1804. This enchanting setting acts as the backdrop for a menu featuring delicious regional specialities....
